bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 重回 5 日和 10 日均线上方

read.en: Amazon rose 3.8% on Nov 18 to $267.74, trading $259.63–268.29. It is above the 5-day ($263.5, falling), 10-day ($264.1), 30-day ($257.5), 100-day ($254.9) and 200-day ($244.9); the last four are rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram widening again after nearly closing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($248.26), and RSI is 57.2.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月18日上涨 3.8%，收于 $267.74，盘中区间 $259.63–268.29。股价位于 5 日（$263.5，下行）、10 日（$264.1）、30 日（$257.5）、100 日（$254.9）和 200 日均线（$244.9）上方；后四者均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图几近收拢后再度放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$248.26），RSI 为 57.2。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $258.5–260.2 and $262.9–263.9 resistances (5 and 10-day), now support. Resistance is $268.3–270.9 (Nov 18 and 13 highs, Nov 10 close), then $271.5–275.3 (Nov 4–12 highs) and $287.2 (52-week high). Support is $263.5–264.1, then $257.5–259.6 (30-day, Nov 18 low) and $252.3–254.9 (100-day). A close above $270.9 would target $275.3; below $263.5, $257.5–259.6.
